problem.statement: Count connected groups of 1s in a 2D grid using 4-direction adjacency.

grid.meaning: The 2D matrix of cells, including the cell values and visited-state representation.

r.meaning: The row index of the current cell.

c.meaning: The column index of the current cell.

count.meaning: The number of connected groups discovered so far.

stack.meaning: The cells pending exploration for the currently discovered connected group.

representation_requirements.description: Represent the input as a 2D grid whose cells can be inspected by row and column coordinates.
Represent each cell position as the pair (r, c).
Represent adjacency using exactly the four orthogonal neighbors of a cell.
Represent visited land cells explicitly so they are not added to the traversal frontier more than once.
Represent the active connected component's pending cells in stack.
Represent count as the number of completed connected components discovered during the grid scan.

semantic_invariants.statement: Every current coordinate (r, c) refers to a valid position in grid before that cell is inspected.
Two cells are connected only when one is directly above, below, left, or right of the other; diagonal contact does not establish adjacency.
Each land cell is marked visited before or when it is added to stack, so no land cell is added more than once.
Every cell in stack is an in-bounds, unvisited land cell belonging to the connected component currently being explored.
When stack becomes empty, every land cell in the current connected component has been visited.
count equals the number of connected components fully discovered in the portion of the grid processed so far.

completion_evidence.description: The cell positions and their row and column coordinates are identified consistently.
The connected-group definition and four-direction adjacency rule are stated correctly.
The visited representation prevents duplicate processing of a land cell.
A discovered group is explored until stack is empty, with valid neighbors added to the frontier.
The final count is accumulated once per discovered group after the grid scan is complete.

terminal_behavior: Scan every cell in grid in a deterministic order.
When an unvisited land cell is found, increment count and explore its entire four-direction connected component using stack.
Mark eligible land cells visited when they enter the traversal frontier.
Terminate when the grid scan is complete and stack is empty.
Return count; return 0 when the grid contains no land cells.
